basic_info.description: First time on the Market - owned by the same family for over 42 years!  With good bones, great flow & character this home is waiting to become the Belle of the Ball with a light makeover or the Grande Dame with the build out of the lower level. This Outer Parkside location is graced by the New Great Highway Park and Ocean Beach within 200 feet. Surfers and ocean lovers will love this location.  Location location location   You'll find 2 generous bedrooms and bathroom on the upper level.  Lower level has 1 bedroom room and room to develop part of the garage into living space and a bathroom.  For an end user you'll love it that you can redo the baths & kitchen to just the way you want or bring your contractor to expand. For a developer you'll love that you can expand within the envelope & maximize profits. Either way, this is house is a great opportunity.
